description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the Path module, including help text, entity type alterations, field info, and translation handling related to URL aliases.

classes.name: PathHooks
classes.description: Contains hook implementations for managing URL path aliases, including help text, entity type alterations, field definitions, and translation handling.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help content for different route pages related to path aliases and URL management.

methods.name: entityTypeAlter
methods.description: Alters the entity type definitions for 'path_alias' to set form classes, handler classes, list builder, and link templates.

methods.name: entityBaseFieldInfoAlter
methods.description: Modifies base field display options for 'path_alias' entity type fields.

methods.name: entityBaseFieldInfo
methods.description: Defines base fields for certain entity types, adding a translatable 'path' field for taxonomy, node, and media entities.

methods.name: entityTranslationCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of translations for path entities, resetting path ID and setting language code.

methods.name: fieldWidgetSingleElementFormAlter
methods.description: Alters form elements for path alias fields, adding descriptions, prefixes, and empty options.
